## NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, released in January 2023, is a voluntary framework designed to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across AI design, development, use, and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector companion profile focused on generative AI. The profile addresses one class of AI, while the broader framework covers AI more generally.

The two publications are related but distinct in scope. AI 600-1’s status as a companion profile does not mean it replaces the broader AI Risk Management Framework.
